data.name: Benish
data.gender_notes: Benish is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'b-n-sh', meaning 'to bestow, to give, to be generous'. This name signifies the bountiful nature of Allah, who is the ultimate giver and sustainer. It is a name that signifies grace, beauty, and generosity. The name Benish carries the meaning “Bountiful, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Benish usually hope their child will grow to embody bountiful, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name carries a deep spiritual meaning, reminding us of the generosity of Allah and inspiring us to be generous towards others.
data.etymology: Benish belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bountiful, Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Benish total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: بنيش
in_arabic.meaning: بنيش اسم بنت معنی دارالسلام کے معنی رکھتا ہے

in_urdu.name: بنیش
in_urdu.meaning: بنیش کا مطلب ہے سکون اور امن کی گہرائیاں
in_urdu.long_meaning: بنیش ایک اردو نام ہے جس کا مطلب 'سکون اور امن کی گہرائیاں' سے ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے بنا ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ بنیش نام کی عورت کو پر سکون، رحمدل اور محبت کرنے والی کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے۔
